method: Root read the concrete disputed replies and prior evidence. Primary and secondary ordinal ratings remain separately preserved; descriptive tables use primary ratings and do not rank the three roles or reviewers. A one-point difference is not a statistically measured quality difference. Findings below govern the report's substantive conclusions.

Design work is known while a more specific job description is not. Retain the narrower known-information omission; avoid saying every uncertainty is false or that the user name is wrong.

Nominalized activity is wrongly flagged. Raw already contains excessive meaning and a subject shift; final removes the concrete subject shift but remains long and abstract. Do not claim every aspect became worse.

The triggering confirmation span is descriptive, not a user task. Final becomes shorter and more aligned with the user's request, but that improvement does not validate the false-positive trigger. Secondary knew the proposed primary score here.

countBoundary: Score tables are primary-review descriptive counts. additionalAdjudications.decision: Primary calls this major; secondary calls it material. Opening reverses the letter direction, but later delivered/read wording has real state support. Preserve the disagreement and do not mark the whole status statement false.

T32 is preventive, and T71 forgets the colleague rather than proving a mix-up. Withdraw alleged historical name confusion; keep the contradicted no-forced-meaning self-report. Primary final block v2 and clusters v2 are authoritative. Original oracle v2 narrow pass unchanged; its broader reason is bounded by this correction.
